title: A priori error analysis for one-parameter Lagrange and POD reduced order methods
summary: This work deals with the numerical solution of parametric linear elliptic partial differential equations using the finite element method for spatial discretization and a proper orthogonal decomposition or Lagrange subspace method based ROM for treating the parameter dependency. We study a simple one-parameter model problem and prove an error estimate for these ROMs as a function of the snapshot point set.
